extends RefCounted
## Pilot primary weapon: hitscan rifle aimed through the camera crosshair.
## All damage flows exclusively through DamageEvent/Damage.apply so pilot gun,
## turrets, mech weapons and enemies stay interchangeable for metrics.

const DamageEvent := preload("res://combat/src/combat/damage_contract.gd")
const Stats := preload("res://combat/data/combat_stats.gd")

var last_hit_end := Vector3.ZERO
var last_hit_damageable := false


func try_fire(space: PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D, cam_origin: Vector3, cam_dir: Vector3,
		muzzle: Vector3, exclude_rid: RID, cooldown_left: float) -> bool:
	if cooldown_left > 0.0:
		return false
	last_hit_end = cam_origin + cam_dir * 80.0
	last_hit_damageable = false
	var q := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(cam_origin, last_hit_end)
	q.exclude = [exclude_rid]
	q.collision_mask = 0xFFFFFFFF
	var hit := space.intersect_ray(q)
	if hit.is_empty():
		return true
	last_hit_end = hit.position
	var collider: Object = hit.collider
	var evt := DamageEvent.new(
		Stats.current.pilot_gun_damage,
		DamageEvent.Source.PILOT_GUN,
		0,
		hit.position,
		collider.is_in_group("weakpoint"))
	last_hit_damageable = DamageEvent.apply(collider, evt)
	return true

extends "res://combat/src/turrets/turret_base.gd"
## CC / control: applies a strong slow with near-zero lethality, preferring
## unslowed targets. Creates kill windows for MG / pilot / future mech —
## deliberately NOT a second DPS tower (damage is symbolic).

const ModelLib := preload("res://combat/src/visuals/model_lib.gd")


func _init() -> void:
	kind = "cc"
	fire_interval = Stats.ensure().cc_interval
	range_f = Stats.ensure().cc_range


func kind_ammo() -> int:
	return Stats.ensure().cc_ammo


func _build_visuals() -> void:
	head = Node3D.new()
	head.position.y = 0.25
	add_child(head)

	if ModelLib.attach_sized(head, "SM_Prop_Turret_Medium_01.fbx",
			Color(0.2, 0.75, 0.95), Vector3.ZERO, 1.0):
		return
	var base := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var cyl := CylinderMesh.new()
	cyl.top_radius = 0.55
	cyl.bottom_radius = 0.75
	cyl.height = 0.5
	base.mesh = cyl
	base.position.y = 0.25
	var bm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	bm.albedo_color = Color(0.3, 0.45, 0.6)
	base.material_override = bm
	add_child(base)

	head.position.y = 0.8

	var crystal := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var octa := PrismMesh.new()
	octa.size = Vector3(0.7, 1.1, 0.7)
	crystal.mesh = octa
	var cm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	cm.albedo_color = Color(0.2, 0.75, 0.95)
	cm.emission_enabled = true
	cm.emission = Color(0.05, 0.35, 0.5)
	cm.emission_energy_multiplier = 1.6
	crystal.material_override = cm
	head.add_child(crystal)


func _accept(e) -> bool:
	return e.slow_left <= 0.0


func _fire(t) -> void:
	t.apply_slow(Stats.ensure().cc_slow_factor, Stats.ensure().cc_slow_duration)
	DamageEvent.apply(t, DamageEvent.new(Stats.ensure().cc_damage,
			DamageEvent.Source.CC_TURRET, get_instance_id(), t.global_position))
	_beam(t.global_position + Vector3.UP * 0.8)


func _beam(to: Vector3) -> void:
	var from := head.global_position
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var cyl := CylinderMesh.new()
	cyl.top_radius = 0.08
	cyl.bottom_radius = 0.02
	cyl.height = maxf(from.distance_to(to), 0.1)
	mi.mesh = cyl
	mi.position = (from + to) * 0.5
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color(0.2, 0.85, 1.0)
	m.emission_enabled = true
	m.emission = Color(0.0, 0.4, 0.55)
	m.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.0
	mi.material_override = m
	get_tree().current_scene.add_child(mi)
	var dir := from.direction_to(to)
	if absf(dir.dot(Vector3.UP)) < 0.99:
		mi.look_at(to, Vector3.UP)
	else:
		mi.look_at(to, Vector3.RIGHT)
	mi.rotate_object_local(Vector3.RIGHT, PI * 0.5)
	get_tree().create_timer(0.12).timeout.connect(mi.queue_free)

extends Node3D
## Authored turret socket: fixed designed placement point, no freeform building.
## Populated by scenario/play config; the socket itself stays dumb.

var socket_name := ""
var kind := "mg"
var pos := Vector3.ZERO
var turret: Node3D = null


func populate(turret_script: GDScript) -> void:
	if turret != null:
		return
	turret = turret_script.new()
	add_child(turret)


func is_populated() -> bool:
	return turret != null and not turret.destroyed

class_name Log
extends RefCounted

## Categorized logging (VS-1 foundation for Proof Contract §6 telemetry).
##
## Categories: RUNTIME NETWORK MISSION CROWD COMBAT PERF.
## Sinks: stdout always; ring buffer for DebugOverlay; file sink under
## user://logs/ when forced with --log-file or in TEST/BENCHMARK modes.
## The first file lines record build identity + seed + mode, so two runs are
## comparable. Call setup() once from boot; shutdown() before quitting.

const RING_CAPACITY := 512
const CATEGORIES: PackedStringArray = ["RUNTIME", "NETWORK", "MISSION", "CROWD", "COMBAT", "PERF"]

static var ring: PackedStringArray = PackedStringArray()
static var _file: FileAccess = null


## Opens the file sink if policy says so and writes the identity header.
static func setup() -> void:
	var want_file: bool = Session.log_file \
		or Session.mode == Session.Mode.TEST \
		or Session.mode == Session.Mode.BENCHMARK
	if not want_file or _file != null:
		return
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute("user://logs")
	var stamp := Time.get_datetime_string_from_system(true).replace(":", "-")
	var path := "user://logs/%s_%s_seed%d.log" % [
		stamp, String(Session.Mode.keys()[Session.mode]).to_lower(), Session.seed_value,
	]
	_file = FileAccess.open(path, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if _file == null:
		printerr("Log: cannot open file sink ", path)
		return
	runtime(Version.label())
	runtime("mode=%s seed=%d port=%d args=%s" % [
		String(Session.Mode.keys()[Session.mode]).to_lower(),
		Session.seed_value, Session.listen_port,
		" ".join(OS.get_cmdline_user_args()),
	])


static func shutdown() -> void:
	if _file != null:
		_file.flush()
		_file = null


static func runtime(msg: String) -> void: write("RUNTIME", msg)
static func network(msg: String) -> void: write("NETWORK", msg)
static func mission(msg: String) -> void: write("MISSION", msg)
static func crowd(msg: String) -> void: write("CROWD", msg)
static func combat(msg: String) -> void: write("COMBAT", msg)
static func perf(msg: String) -> void: write("PERF", msg)


static func write(category: String, msg: String) -> void:
	if not Session.category_enabled(category):
		return
	var line := "[%09d] [%s] %s" % [Time.get_ticks_msec(), category, msg]
	print(line)
	ring.append(line)
	if ring.size() > RING_CAPACITY:
		ring.remove_at(0)
	if _file != null:
		_file.store_line(line)

class_name Net
extends RefCounted

## Sole owner of multiplayer APIs — the VS-1 transport/gameplay seam.
## Gameplay code must never touch MultiplayerAPI / ENetMultiplayerPeer / rpc()
## directly; everything routes through these functions so VS-2 can swap
## internals (GodotSteam spike, latency injection) without touching call sites.
##
## Solo NORMAL mode has no peer: is_server() stays true (single authoritative
## simulation), local_peer_id() is 1.

const MAX_PEERS := 8 # dev headroom over the duo slice; not a design target

static var peer: ENetMultiplayerPeer = null
static var _signals_bound := false


static func start(mode: Session.Mode) -> Error:
	match mode:
		Session.Mode.HOST:
			return _start_server(Session.listen_port)
		Session.Mode.CLIENT:
			return _start_client(Session.connect_address, Session.listen_port)
	return ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER


static func shutdown() -> void:
	var mp := _multiplayer()
	if mp != null:
		mp.multiplayer_peer = null
	peer = null

## True when we own the authoritative simulation (solo or dedicated host).
static func is_server() -> bool:
	if peer == null:
		return true
	return peer.get_connection_status() == MultiplayerPeer.CONNECTION_CONNECTED \
		and _multiplayer() != null and local_peer_id() == 1


static func local_peer_id() -> int:
	var mp := _multiplayer()
	var p := mp.multiplayer_peer if mp != null else null
	# Teardown race guard (wave step 2): ENet get_unique_id() errors out if the
	# peer closed between the null-check and the call (host-drop case). Only a
	# live connection has a meaningful id; otherwise report solo id 1.
	if p != null and p.get_connection_status() == MultiplayerPeer.CONNECTION_CONNECTED:
		return mp.get_unique_id()
	return 1


static func _start_server(port: int) -> Error:
	var p := ENetMultiplayerPeer.new()
	var err: Error = p.create_server(port, MAX_PEERS)
	if err != OK:
		Log.network("host failed on port %d: %s" % [port, error_string(err)])
		return err
	peer = p
	var mp := _multiplayer()
	mp.multiplayer_peer = p
	_bind_peer_signals(mp)
	Log.network("host listening on port %d" % port)
	return OK


static func _start_client(address: String, port: int) -> Error:
	if address.is_empty():
		address = "127.0.0.1" # Session grammar allows bare --connect for localhost dev
	var p := ENetMultiplayerPeer.new()
	var err: Error = p.create_client(address, port)
	if err != OK:
		Log.network("connect to %s:%d failed: %s" % [address, port, error_string(err)])
		return err
	peer = p
	var mp := _multiplayer()
	mp.multiplayer_peer = p
	_bind_peer_signals(mp)
	Log.network("connecting to %s:%d" % [address, port])
	return OK


static func _bind_peer_signals(mp: MultiplayerAPI) -> void:
	# Bind once per process: the SceneTree MultiplayerAPI outlives peer swaps,
	# and re-binding on every start would duplicate handlers.
	if _signals_bound:
		return
	_signals_bound = true
	mp.peer_connected.connect(func(id: int) -> void: Log.network("peer %d connected" % id))
	mp.peer_disconnected.connect(func(id: int) -> void: Log.network("peer %d disconnected" % id))


static func _multiplayer() -> MultiplayerAPI:
	var tree := Engine.get_main_loop() as SceneTree
	return tree.get_multiplayer() if tree != null else null

class_name RngService
extends RefCounted

## Determinism baseline (VS-1): every gameplay-random number must come from a
## named stream derived from Session.seed_value. Calling randomize() anywhere
## in game/** is forbidden — it would silently break benchmark/test replay.
##
## Streams are lazily created and cached per process. Same seed + same stream
## name => same number sequence for a given engine build.

const SEPARATOR := "::"

static var _streams: Dictionary = {}


static func reset() -> void:
	_streams.clear()


static func stream(stream_name: String) -> RandomNumberGenerator:
	if _streams.has(stream_name):
		return _streams[stream_name]
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = derive_seed(Session.seed_value, stream_name)
	_streams[stream_name] = rng
	return rng


## Stable across runs for a given engine version (String.hash is unseeded).
static func derive_seed(session_seed: int, stream_name: String) -> int:
	return hash("%d%s%s" % [session_seed, SEPARATOR, stream_name])

class_name CrowdRenderer
extends Node3D

## MultiMesh crowd renderer. One draw call for the whole horde.
## Stage A: plain boxes, StandardMaterial.
## Stage B: ShaderMaterial with TIME-based wiggle (animation proxy),
##          per-instance variation derived in-shader from MODEL_MATRIX,
##          so no per-instance custom data and no swap-recycle bugs.

const COLOR_MOVE := Color(0.85, 0.45, 0.35)
const COLOR_ATTACK := Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.15)
const COLOR_DEAD := Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)

var sim: CrowdSim
var mmi: MultiMeshInstance3D
var mm: MultiMesh
var stage_b := false

# per-slot mirrors so we only touch color/yaw on change
var _last_state := PackedByteArray()
var _last_yaw := PackedFloat32Array()
var us_sync := 0


func setup(p_sim: CrowdSim, p_stage_b: bool) -> void:
	sim = p_sim
	stage_b = p_stage_b
	mmi = MultiMeshInstance3D.new()
	mm = MultiMesh.new()
	mm.transform_format = MultiMesh.TRANSFORM_3D
	mm.use_colors = true
	mm.mesh = BoxMesh.new()
	(mm.mesh as BoxMesh).size = Vector3(0.45, 0.9, 0.45)
	if stage_b:
		var sh := ShaderMaterial.new()
		sh.shader = load("res://scenes/wiggle.gdshader")
		mmi.material_override = sh
	else:
		var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
		mat.vertex_color_use_as_albedo = true
		mmi.material_override = mat
	# instance_count must be set before filling buffers
	mm.instance_count = sim.cap
	mm.visible_instance_count = 0
	var t := Transform3D.IDENTITY
	for i in range(sim.cap):
		mm.set_instance_color(i, COLOR_MOVE)
		mm.set_instance_transform(i, t)
	_last_state.resize(sim.cap)
	_last_state.fill(255)
	_last_yaw.resize(sim.cap)
	add_child(mmi)


func sync() -> void:
	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	var n := sim.active
	for i in range(n):
		var vx := sim.vx[i]
		var vz := sim.vz[i]
		if vx * vx + vz * vz > 0.04:
			_last_yaw[i] = atan2(vx, vz)
		var yaw := _last_yaw[i]
		var b := Basis(Vector3.UP, yaw)
		var tr := Transform3D(b, Vector3(sim.px[i], 0.45, sim.pz[i]))
		mm.set_instance_transform(i, tr)
		var st := sim.state[i]
		if st != _last_state[i]:
			_last_state[i] = st
			match st:
				CrowdSim.ST_ATTACK:
					mm.set_instance_color(i, COLOR_ATTACK)
				CrowdSim.ST_MOVE:
					mm.set_instance_color(i, COLOR_MOVE)
				_:
					mm.set_instance_color(i, COLOR_DEAD)
	mm.visible_instance_count = n
	us_sync += Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0


func take_sync_us() -> int:
	var v := us_sync
	us_sync = 0
	return v
